steps.check_question: Are there two white bars on a green background?

steps.title: Crease the fold and unfold it

steps.check_question: Are there four white bars on a red background?

steps.title: Open the finished shape
steps.check_question: Are there five white bars on a purple background?

transcript.text: Start with the sheet flat on the table.
Make sure the colored side faces down.
Now fold it in half, edge to edge.
Crease it hard, then unfold it again.
Bring each corner to the center point.
Open it up and you are done.
